trans-unit.note: Menu item shown when keyboard-only mode is off. Keep short: appears in the macOS menu bar dropdown.
Menu item shown when keyboard-only mode is on (replaces menu.clean_screen). Keep short.
Menu checkbox item toggling keyboard-only mode.
Menu submenu title grouping the cleaning color choice (Black/White).
Menu submenu item: the black cleaning screen color.
Menu submenu item: the white cleaning screen color.
Menu submenu title grouping the fail-safe auto-unlock delay choices.
Menu submenu item: auto-unlock after 30 seconds.
Menu submenu item: auto-unlock after 60 seconds.
Menu submenu item: auto-unlock after 90 seconds.

trans-unit.target: Mostra icona nella barra dei menu
trans-unit.note: Menu checkbox: whether to keep showing the Urahafu icon in the menu bar.
Menu checkbox: whether Urahafu launches automatically at login.
Menu item opening the About alert.
Menu item opening the project's GitHub page in the browser.
Menu item quitting the app.

Menu item shown above 'Clean Screen'/'Clean Keyboard' (followed by a separator) only while Accessibility access is missing; opens System Settings on the Accessibility pane. Disappears once access is granted.
Title of the confirmation alert shown before hiding the menu bar icon.

trans-unit.source: Urahafu will start cleaning right away each time you open it. To get this menu back, hold Option while opening Urahafu.
trans-unit.target: Urahafu avvierà subito la pulizia ogni volta che lo apri. Per ritrovare questo menu, tieni premuto il tasto Option mentre apri Urahafu.
trans-unit.note: Body of the hide-icon confirmation alert. Explains that Urahafu will clean immediately on launch, and how to get the menu back (hold Option while opening).
Default (destructive) button of the hide-icon confirmation alert.
Cancel button of the hide-icon confirmation alert.
Label shown above the big countdown digit before cleaning starts. Unlike the digit itself (3, 2, 1) this text does not change between seconds, so it must not reference a specific count.
Small hint below the countdown digit explaining how to cancel it.
The app's wordmark shown on the full-screen cleaning overlay. This is a proper noun (the app's name) and must stay 'urahafu', unchanged, in every language.

trans-unit.source: Hold the close button for 2 seconds to unlock
trans-unit.target: Tieni premuta la croce per 2 secondi per sbloccare
trans-unit.note: Full-screen overlay hint explaining the hold-to-unlock gesture. Spells out 'close button' in words rather than using the ✕ glyph inline: next to a number ('✕ 2 seconds') the glyph would read as a multiplication sign. Never use ✕ or × in this string.

trans-unit.source: To unlock, hold the close button for 2 seconds
trans-unit.target: Per sbloccare, tieni premuta la croce per 2 secondi
trans-unit.note: Countdown screen's explanation of the hold-to-unlock gesture, shown while the countdown to locking is still running. Same wording constraint as overlay.hint.hold_to_unlock: spell out the button, never use ✕ or ×.
Keyboard-only mode HUD: compact pill shown while the keyboard is locked. Keep this very short, it renders in a small rounded pill.
Keyboard-only mode HUD: compact hold-to-unlock hint next to the ✕ button. Keep very short (HUD pill). Spell out 'button' in words, never use ✕ or × inline next to the number.
Title of the welcome alert shown once on first launch in menu-bar mode, whatever the Accessibility permission state.

trans-unit.source: Urahafu lets you clean your screen and keyboard without triggering anything. Its icon is in the menu bar, at the top right of the screen. While cleaning, press and hold the close button at the bottom of the screen for 2 seconds to unlock; otherwise the screen unlocks by itself after the delay you chose.
trans-unit.target: Urahafu ti permette di pulire lo schermo e la tastiera senza attivare nulla. La sua icona si trova nella barra dei menu, in alto a destra dello schermo. Durante la pulizia, tieni premuto il pulsante di chiusura in basso sullo schermo per 2 secondi per sbloccare; altrimenti lo schermo si sblocca da solo dopo il tempo scelto.
trans-unit.note: Body of the welcome alert: explains where to find the menu bar icon (easy to miss) and the hold-to-unlock gesture, since the app only ever shows a small icon otherwise. Shown whatever the Accessibility permission state.
Button of the welcome alert shown when Accessibility access is still missing; leads into the existing first-launch permission alert (first_launch.*) right after.
Title of the first-launch alert asking for Accessibility permission.

trans-unit.source: To block the keyboard and trackpad while you clean, allow Urahafu in System Settings › Privacy & Security › Accessibility. Urahafu never records or sends what you type, and never connects to the internet.
trans-unit.target: Per bloccare la tastiera e il trackpad durante la pulizia, autorizza Urahafu in Impostazioni di Sistema › Privacy e sicurezza › Accessibilità. Urahafu non registra né invia mai quello che digiti, e non si connette a Internet.
trans-unit.note: Body of the first-launch alert. Explains why Accessibility access is needed, the exact System Settings path, and reassures that Urahafu never records keystrokes or connects to the internet. Use the official macOS 13+ System Settings labels for this language (System Settings › Privacy & Security → Accessibility).
Default button of the first-launch alert, opens System Settings.
Secondary button of the first-launch alert, dismisses without opening Settings.

trans-unit.source: You're all set! While cleaning, press and hold the close button at the bottom of the screen for 2 seconds to unlock. Otherwise the screen unlocks by itself after the delay you chose.
trans-unit.target: Tutto pronto! Durante la pulizia, tieni premuta la croce in fondo allo schermo per 2 secondi per sbloccare. Altrimenti lo schermo si sblocca da solo dopo il tempo scelto.
trans-unit.note: Body of the confirmation alert shown once Accessibility access has been granted, explaining the hold-to-unlock gesture and the fail-safe auto-unlock.
OK button of the first-launch-ready confirmation alert.
Title of the error alert shown when Accessibility access is missing at cleaning time.

trans-unit.source: Urahafu can't block the keyboard without this permission. Cleaning did not start.
trans-unit.target: Urahafu non può bloccare la tastiera senza questa autorizzazione. La pulizia non è iniziata.
trans-unit.note: Body of the permission-missing error alert.
Default button of the permission-missing alert, opens System Settings.
Title of the error alert shown when the keyboard event tap could not be installed.

trans-unit.source: Cleaning did not start so you never get stuck. Try again; if it keeps happening, log out and back in.
trans-unit.target: La pulizia non è iniziata, così non resti mai bloccato. Riprova; se il problema persiste, esci e accedi di nuovo.
trans-unit.note: Body of the event-tap-failed error alert, suggests retrying or logging out and back in.
Title of the error alert shown when macOS Secure Input is blocking Urahafu.

trans-unit.source: Another app (often an open password field) is preventing Urahafu from blocking the keyboard. Close that field or app, then try again.
trans-unit.target: Un'altra app (spesso un campo password aperto) impedisce a Urahafu di bloccare la tastiera. Chiudi quel campo o quell'app, poi riprova.
trans-unit.note: Body of the Secure-Input-active error alert, suggests closing the app or field responsible.
Default button on error alerts, retries the action.
Cancel button shared by several alerts.

trans-unit.source: Clean your screen and keyboard without triggering anything.
trans-unit.target: Pulisci lo schermo e la tastiera senza attivare nulla.
trans-unit.note: Tagline shown in the About alert, under the app name.
License line shown in the About alert.
Secondary button in the About alert, opens the GitHub repository.
Default (OK) button in the About alert.

Keyboard-only mode's countdown label counting down to the keyboard lock, e.g. 'Locking in' 3, 2, 1. {n} is the remaining digit (a single-digit integer, no unit needed unless natural in this language).

trans-unit.source: Space: dead-pixel test · Auto-unlock in {seconds} s
trans-unit.target: Spazio: test dei pixel morti · Sblocco automatico tra {seconds} s
trans-unit.note: Second line of text on the full-screen cleaning overlay: dead-pixel test hint plus the remaining fail-safe auto-unlock time. {seconds} is the number of seconds left, always shown with plain digits (0-9), never native digit forms.
Version line shown in the About alert, e.g. 'Version 1.0.0'. {version} is the crate's semantic version string, inserted verbatim (never translated or reformatted).
